thought.text: Ini kabar bagus: **tidak ada captcha** di halaman signup Venice. Sekarang saya uji benar-benar mendaftar.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && DISPLAY=:99 timeout 240 python3 - <<'PY' 2>&1 | tail -22
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
import time
email=f"vt{int(time.time())}@sinaja.cyou"
print("email:",email)
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b=p.chromium.launch(headless=False,args=["--no-sandbox"])
    ctx=b.new_context()
    pg=ctx.new_page()
    reqs=[]
    pg.on("request",lambda r: reqs.append((r.method,r.url)) if "/api/" in r.url else None)
    pg.goto("https://venice.ai/sign-up",wait_until="domcontentloaded",timeout=60000)
    pg.wait_for_timeout(5000)
    pg.fill('input[name="emailAddress"]',email)
    pg.fill('input[name="password"]',"Str0ng!Pass123")
    pg.click("text=Continue")
    pg.wait_for_timeout(9000)
    print("URL:",pg.url)
    print("teks:",pg.inner_text("body")[:400].replace("\n"," | "))
    print("--- api calls ---")
    for m,u in reqs[-10:]: print(" ",m,u[:110])
    b.close()
PY
